Connect to a remote server

Connection details stay in this browser and are never stored in the repository.

1. On the server (over SSH, once)

curl -fsSL https://@OWNER@.github.io@BASE@/install-server.sh | bash

This installs the matching server under ~/.vscode-web-remote if needed, starts it on loopback and prints a token. It does not touch ~/.vscode-server.

2. Forward the port

Use your SSH app's local port forward (through your jump host) to 127.0.0.1:18765 on the server.

3. Connect
